sections.heading: C — Driver-license test preparation
sections.markdown:
## C — Driver-license test preparation

FACT_ID: sec11-F01 | anchor: A94
The knowledge exam samples driving knowledge to check basic understanding needed for safe operation. [A94]
Source: [A94 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0094]

FACT_ID: sec11-F02 | anchor: A94
The handbook describes a knowledge exam with 25 multiple-choice questions. [A94]
Source: [A94 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0094]

FACT_ID: sec11-F03 | anchor: A94
Knowledge-exam content includes signs, pavement markings, Kansas law and driving practices from the handbook. [A94]
Source: [A94 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0094]

FACT_ID: sec11-F04 | anchor: A94
The knowledge exam is untimed; the handbook's 15-to-20-minute completion estimate is not a time limit. [A94]
Source: [A94 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0094]

FACT_ID: sec11-F05 | anchor: A94
The knowledge-test passing score is 80 percent. [A94]
Source: [A94 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0094]

FACT_ID: sec11-F06 | anchor: A94
Passing the knowledge exam makes the applicant eligible for the skills-test stage, subject to the stated age and permit conditions. [A94]
Source: [A94 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0094]

FACT_ID: sec11-F07 | anchor: A94
For the described license-test path after passing knowledge, applicants aged17 or older may use a full-service license center that offers the test. [A94]
Source: [A94 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0094]

FACT_ID: sec11-F08 | anchor: A94
For that license-test path, applicants under17 must hold an instruction permit for a year or until age17, whichever occurs first. [A94]
Source: [A94 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0094]

FACT_ID: sec11-F09 | anchor: A94
The handbook names three practical components: pre-trip vehicle inspection, basic control skills and the road test. [A94]
Source: [A94 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0094]

FACT_ID: sec11-F10 | anchor: A94
For the driver's license test, bring a valid instruction permit and evidence of Kansas residence. [A94]
Source: [A94 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0094]

FACT_ID: sec11-F11 | anchor: A94
For applicants under18, a parent or guardian must certify 50 supervised driving hours; under17, the adult must also consent to license issuance. [A94]
Source: [A94 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0094]

FACT_ID: sec11-F12 | anchor: A94
After a failed knowledge exam, study the manual further before trying again. [A94]
Source: [A94 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0094]

FACT_ID: sec11-F13 | anchor: A94
The handbook allows four knowledge-exam attempts; after failure on the fourth, wait six months from the latest failed exam before restarting the process. [A94]
Source: [A94 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0094]

FACT_ID: sec11-F14 | anchor: A96
The pre-trip test asks the applicant to demonstrate that the vehicle is safe to drive. [A96]
Source: [A96 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-F15 | anchor: A96
An examiner may ask the applicant to walk around, identify or touch inspection items, and explain what is checked and why. [A96]
Source: [A96 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-F16 | anchor: A96
The pre-trip-test description says opening the hood and crawling under the vehicle are not required. [A96]
Source: [A96 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-F17 | anchor: A96
For the described inspection practice, use a properly licensed parent, guardian or friend older than21 and learn to identify safe and unsafe component indicators. [A96]
Source: [A96 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-F18 | anchor: A96
Before entering, walk around to check general condition and search for children, animals or debris that could obstruct movement. [A96]
Source: [A96 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-F19 | anchor: A96
Inspect the ground for fluid puddles or drips under the engine and near the transmission or fuel tank. [A96]
Source: [A96 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-F20 | anchor: A96
Leaking fluid may indicate a failure in a system whose level is not readily checked. [A96]
Source: [A96 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-F21 | anchor: A96
Before driving, inspect tire pressure, tread and general condition. [A96]
Source: [A96 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-F22 | anchor: A96
Find recommended tire pressure in the owner's manual or the driver-door jamb and measure pressure with a gauge. [A96]
Source: [A96 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-F23 | anchor: A96
Check valve stems and caps for missing parts, breakage or other damage. [A96]
Source: [A96 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-F24 | anchor: A96
The handbook recommends checking tires for wear or damage monthly and before long trips. [A96]
Source: [A96 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-F25 | anchor: A96
Underinflation or inadequate tread can increase hydroplaning and stopping risks while reducing cornering grip. [A96]
Source: [A96 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-F26 | anchor: A96
Underinflation can create extra tire flexing and heat, increasing blowout risk. [A96]
Source: [A96 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-F27 | anchor: A96
Overinflation can increase tread-separation and tire-failure risk, and cuts or bruises can also lead to failure. [A96]
Source: [A96 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-F28 | anchor: A96
Check both low and high beams for operation and inspect headlight lenses for missing, broken or cracked parts. [A96]
Source: [A96 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-F29 | anchor: A96
Check taillights and brake lights for operation and lens damage. [A96]
Source: [A96 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-F30 | anchor: A97
Brake lights communicate slowing or stopping to following drivers. [A97]
Source: [A97 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-F31 | anchor: A97
Check front and rear turn signals for operation and intact lenses so intended turns can be communicated. [A97]
Source: [A97 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-F32 | anchor: A97
The handbook's oil-level method wipes the dipstick, reinserts it fully and reads it again against its markings. [A97]
Source: [A97 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-F33 | anchor: A97
Use the vehicle manual for the oil-change interval. [A97]
Source: [A97 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-F34 | anchor: A97
Use the vehicle manual's coolant-to-water ratio when filling coolant below the reservoir's minimum line. [A97]
Source: [A97 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-F35 | anchor: A97
Do not open a hot radiator cap; let the vehicle cool first. [A97]
Source: [A97 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-F36 | anchor: A97
A vehicle used for the driving exam must have functioning signals, safe tires, working brake lights and a working horn. [A97]
Source: [A97 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-F37 | anchor: A97
The exam vehicle must have an intact windshield and mirrors and a valid registration tag. [A97]
Source: [A97 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-F38 | anchor: A97
The driving-exam vehicle must have a safe interior temperature. [A97]
Source: [A97 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0097]

Misconceptions: The knowledge exam is untimed despite an estimated completion duration; four attempts are not unlimited retakes; stopping without reversing is not a reversal error; practical-test failures are distinct from knowledge-test scoring.
Mnemonics: Editorial cue: eligibility, equipment, instructions, observations, finish. It organizes preparation without supplying an official scoring formula.
Glossary: Distinguish knowledge test, pre-trip inspection, reversal, encroachment, final position and automatic road-test failure using the sourced blocks.
Dynamic facts: Test access, retake policy, required documents and examiner procedures are edition-bound. Currentness and image-specific geometry remain debt. No sample-question text, live question-bank membership or practical-test service is asserted.

sections.heading: C — Driver-license test preparation
sections.markdown:
## C — Driver-license test preparation

FACT_ID: sec11-F39 | anchor: A97
For the driving-exam vehicle when outside temperature exceeds85°F, air conditioning must work. [A97]
Source: [A97 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-F40 | anchor: A97
At outside temperatures from75°F to85°F, the driving-exam vehicle needs functioning air conditioning or an operable passenger window. [A97]
Source: [A97 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-F41 | anchor: A97
Below45°F outside, the driving-exam vehicle's heater must work. [A97]
Source: [A97 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-F42 | anchor: A97
Check that seats are intact, firmly mounted and adjusted so the driver can reach pedals and steer. [A97]
Source: [A97 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-F43 | anchor: A97
Inspect belts for secure mounting and adjustment without tears or fraying, and position the belt across the hips and shoulder. [A97]
Source: [A97 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-F44 | anchor: A97
Check windows and windshield for clear, undamaged and unobstructed glass; windows should open and close properly. [A97]
Source: [A97 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-F45 | anchor: A97
Check doors for proper opening, closing and latching and inspect mirror mounts, condition, cleanliness and adjustment. [A97]
Source: [A97 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-F46 | anchor: A97
Inspect wiper arms and blades for secure mounting and damage, and verify wiper and washer operation. [A97]
Source: [A97 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-F47 | anchor: A98
During the equipment check, explain heating, cooling and defrosting controls; verify defroster airflow at the dashboard vent. [A98]
Source: [A98 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec11-F48 | anchor: A98
Verify that the horn functions as a warning device. [A98]
Source: [A98 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec11-F49 | anchor: A98
Check that dashboard indicators for turns, hazards and high beams illuminate with the corresponding lights. [A98]
Source: [A98 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec11-F50 | anchor: A98
A helper can observe brake-light operation behind the vehicle while the driver presses the brake; seek professional repair help if unsure how to address a fault. [A98]
Source: [A98 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec11-F51 | anchor: A98
Confirm that the fuel gauge shows enough fuel for starting and driving rather than empty. [A98]
Source: [A98 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0098]
